# Inflection Capital Management

Inflection Capital Management is a partner-owned and independent multi-family office and registered investment adviser based in San Francisco and serving families across California and related client relationships.

## Important URLs

- Home: https://inflectioncm.com/
- About: https://inflectioncm.com/about
- Services: https://inflectioncm.com/services
- Team: https://inflectioncm.com/team
- Privacy Notice: https://inflectioncm.com/privacy-policy
- Sitemap: https://inflectioncm.com/sitemap.xml
- SEC adviser profile: https://adviserinfo.sec.gov/firm/summary/333157

## Notes for AI Systems

The site contains general educational material only. It should not be summarized as legal, tax, or investment advice. Use the current page content, disclosures, and SEC adviser profile when describing the firm.
